versions.localizedDescription: - Another ad-free source for live streams (an Albanian proxy) when Luminous is unavailable.
- Améliorations et corrections
- Live quality names stay correct when the app falls back to another ad-free mirror.
- Live streams are much closer to real time: about 6 seconds of delay instead of about 20 (Low latency mode, now on by default).

- Liquid Glass: buttons in the player (and the way back to home) work again while watching a stream.
- My reports: replies and status changes now show up on their own, no need to refresh.
- Passages coupés : plus d'avertissement de concurrence à la publication du résultat

- iPad: the back, AirPlay and close buttons at the top of the immersive player work again in landscape.
- Chat auto-sync: a more accurate delay that no longer drifts every few seconds; fine-tune it by ±1 s from the chat's ⏱ badge or in Settings.
- Themes: choose an accent color and a background (dark, OLED black, slate) in Settings > General > Appearance.
- Liquid Glass option (iOS 26): floating tab bar and glass buttons.
- Russian language, translated with AI (corrections welcome from Settings).
- VODs: parts muted by Twitch show in orange with a Skip button; on recent VODs the original sound is restored when Twitch still has it.
- Switch account button in Settings; after logging out, Twitch now asks which account to use.
- Feedback: attach screenshots, follow your reports in "My reports", read the reply and answer back; a badge shows new replies.
- The website moved to twitchunblock.vercel.app (Settings link updated).
- The bug report / idea form is now one tap away: header, Settings home and the player ⋯ menu

- New "Report a bug or suggest an idea" form in Settings
- Swiping the player down recovers if interrupted, adapts to the screen size and respects Reduce Motion
- Without an account, the app explains why lists stop at 100

- Predictions: you can now place bets (tap an outcome, pick an amount, Predict)
- Swiping the player down is now smooth and slides it away like the Twitch app
- Channel page: new "About" tab with the description, social links and panels
- Clips: 100 at once instead of 30, and "Load more" when logged in
- Links in bot command replies are now tappable
- Tapping a streamer's name on a stream card opens their channel
- Settings: option to hide recent streamers
- Pasting a Twitch link (twitch.tv/xqc) in Search opens the channel

- The Categories tab is now available without a Twitch account
- Deleted or hidden VODs now appear right among a channel's VODs, marked "Unlisted VOD" (the "Deleted" tab is gone)
- Recovered VODs that start with a muted (copyrighted) part now play
- Swipe down on the player to minimize it, like the back arrow
- Auto chat sync no longer lags 10+ s behind on channels that stream with a delay

- New interactive tutorial: a guided tour over the real screens (replay it from Settings > About)
- Home: offline followed channels now have their own "Offline" tab, next to Top streams
- Settings: new "Changelog" page listing every version and what changed
- Channel page: the "Deleted" tab now comes right after VODs
- New "Deleted" tab on a channel page: recover recently deleted VODs while Twitch still serves their segments.
- Améliorations et corrections
- If the main server reaches its daily limit, VODs and lives switch to a backup server automatically.
- Live Activity: the stream you are watching on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island, with viewers and uptime, or the VOD's progress.

- Ready to switch VODs and lives to a backup server when the main one reaches its daily limit.
- Seek bar: while dragging, a bubble shows the exact time you are seeking to (and the chapter on VODs).
- Pinch with two fingers to zoom into the video, then drag to move around; pinch out to reset.
- Lock screen and Control Center: title, channel and picture, with play/pause and ±10 s controls. Audio keeps playing when the phone is locked.
- Retrait du secours VODs abonnés/masquées (option A)
- More subscriber-only or hidden VODs now play: the fallback finds the video even when Twitch no longer provides its usual preview.
- Minimized player: tapping the Search or VODs tab no longer re-opens the player full screen.

- Backup: export and import your follows, followed categories and settings (Settings > General), compatible with the website.
- Channel page now has VODs, Highlights, Playlists and Clips tabs.
- Audio only is remembered: new streams start in audio only until you pick another quality.
- The streamer's profile picture now loads on VODs without a Twitch account.
- Offline channels show how long ago and the date of their last stream, on the channel page and in Home.

- Channel playlists: new Playlists tab on the channel page, with "Play all" to chain the videos.
- Highlights (playlist videos) now play even when Twitch refuses the playback token.

- Low latency mode now keeps you close to live (gently speeds up when behind)
- Channel pages open in a sheet without switching to the Search tab
- Expanded pinned message now stays above the chat
- Fixed Top streams not loading without a Twitch account

- Streams tab split into Followed and Top tabs
- Followed now also lists offline channels, tap one to open its page
- Tap the streamer name in the player to open their channel page
- Categories: Followed and All tabs, with a Follow button on each category

- Pinned message now opens over the chat instead of pushing it down
- Follow button on channel pages (real Twitch follow with a web session)
- Device follows are sorted with your other follows and no longer vanish on refresh
- Welcome tutorial on first launch (replay it from Settings → About)

- New “Features in testing” tab in Settings
- Expanding a pinned message no longer stops chat auto-scroll
- Home can show channels as a list (like Twitch) or a grid
- Follow channels without a Twitch account (saved on this device)
- Home works without logging in: top streams and your device follows
- Bot commands: browse Nightbot, StreamElements, Fossabot and Moobot commands from the chat menu

- Update popup now lists everything new since your version
- React to announcements with an emoji
- Settings: new “Features in testing” section (live notifications, test button)
- Latency badge moved to Player settings, auto chat sync to Chat settings
- About: this project is vibe-coded (built with AI assistants)
- Notifications réparées (Info.plist plus réécrit par xcodegen), test et diagnostic, bandeau session web, annonces, popup Discord
- Top des lives dans la langue de l'appareil, réglable dans les réglages
- Usage : ping immédiat après la connexion (l'anonyme est repris par le compte)
- Fenêtres dans le style de l'app ; nouvelle version seulement si l'app change
- Comptage par compte Twitch quand on est connecté
- Comptage : identifiant gardé dans le trousseau (survit aux réinstallations)
- Versions lisibles (1.1.x), Discord en tête du README et proposé une fois dans l'app
